What Apple Enterprise Single Sign-On actually does — listing honesty

Apple supports Enterprise Single Sign-On on supervised and managed Apple devices so organization users can sign into enterprise apps once via an identity provider — using Extensible SSO (SSO extensions), Platform SSO (macOS system-level org authentication), or Kerberos SSO for org apps that integrate with the organization's Kerberos realm. IT admins configure SSO extension payloads through MDM; users authenticate once and access org apps without re-entering credentials per app. Third-party MDM, Mac-admin, IdP, and enterprise-mobility apps may complement this by monitoring SSO status, documenting IdP integration, or educating IT about Enterprise SSO best practices. Enterprise SSO–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Org authentication and SSO extension marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Enterprise SSO — not a literal paste of US marketing:

单点登录 (Single Sign-On / Enterprise SSO)

Apple's Chinese MDM and enterprise support materials use 单点登录 for org authentication where users sign into enterprise apps once via an IdP. Enterprise marketing also uses 企业 SSO when emphasizing organization-scoped single sign-on on managed Apple devices. AppLocale picks the term IT admins recognize on each screenshot — an IdP sign-in flow frame needs 单点登录-friendly phrasing; a benefit headline may use 企业 SSO when accurate to your English source.

SSO 扩展 (SSO extension / Extensible SSO)

US pages use "SSO extension" or "Extensible SSO" when describing the authentication extension framework that lets org apps participate in Enterprise SSO on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. China storefront copy often uses SSO 扩展 or 可扩展 SSO on frames that explain how org apps integrate with the IdP authentication path — distinct from generic "login plugin" terminology.

平台 SSO (Platform SSO)

Apple documentation describes macOS system-level org authentication through Platform SSO. zh-Hans marketing uses 平台 SSO on frames that explain how managed Macs authenticate users at the OS level via the organization's IdP — separate from per-app SSO extension flows on iPhone and iPad gallery frames.

Kerberos SSO

Enterprise environments with Active Directory or Kerberos realms may market Kerberos SSO for org apps on managed Apple devices. zh-Hans copy may retain Kerberos SSO as a recognized enterprise term alongside 单点登录 on frames where your English source specifically claims Kerberos realm integration — not generic "passwordless login" overclaims.

IdP 集成 (IdP integration)

The primary org benefit of Enterprise SSO is seamless authentication through the organization's identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Ping, or other SAML/OIDC IdPs. zh-Hans copy uses IdP 集成 or 身份提供商集成 on benefit headlines and description paragraphs — the commerce hook Chinese IT buyers expect when evaluating SSO extension ROI.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need enterprise search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 单点登录, 企业 SSO, and SSO 扩展 each signal different intent from 托管 Apple ID, 配置描述文件, or consumer Sign in with Apple keywords.

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Enterprise SSO" headlines on gallery frames showing IdP sign-in flows or SSO extension dashboards — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.
